title: 第十四章 、踏着尸体活下来，恶有恶报，不是不报，时候未到
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“嗯，我们都欠大小姐一条命，大小姐有需要，尽管打电话找我。”

梦煜将自己的联系方式以小纸条形式写下来，送到端木棠梨手里。

老赵和老吴二人看到梦煜的动作，跟着一起在纸条上留下自己的联系方式，意识很明显，之前在小游戏里面说过事情都有效，只要大小姐有事要他们做，不涉及人品道德和违法犯罪的事情，都可以打电话来找他们帮忙。

端木棠梨没有跟这些人客气，将纸条给收了起来。

如今世道不知道会变成什么样子，多一条人脉，多一份帮助，对她百利而无害。

“咦？我的姐诶！那个老四只是断了一个胳膊，人没有被抹杀。”

米樱闻笙惊愕看着独臂的老四完好无损坐在自己原来的位置上，刚才他只是觉得有哪里不对劲，特得观看包厢全景，才将老四的身影找了出来。

“想必是手里有什么特殊道具，踩着其他两人尸体活下来的。”

梦怡正眼都不带看老四一眼，这种踩着别人尸体活下来的人，是她最讨厌的类型。

作为要考法官的人，她对于老四这种间接杀人犯很是厌恶，语气十分恶劣。

“嗯，梦怡说的没错，这人应该跟之前被狼女带走的人一样，踏着其他人尸体活下来的，我们需要对他打起十二分精神，不能被其算计。”

端木棠梨肯定了梦怡的想法。

“大小姐别那么紧张，跟你有重大间隙是老三和老六，我在小游戏里面，可没有跟你起过任何冲突。”

“果然会咬人的狗不叫，你的好兄弟们死得不冤。”

对于老三老六死了都要被老四拿来利用，端木棠梨对于这人感官更差了。

只不过碍于列车上文明乘车规则，端木棠梨不好直接动手收拾这人。

幸好下一站时间到了，端木棠梨也就把干掉对方的想法放在一边，等到下车回归现实生活中，肯定跟老四分道扬镳，多思考无意。

“积木叠叠高到了，请按铃的乘客从后门下车，欢迎你下次再来G444号黄泉路列车乘坐。”

老四被端木棠梨怼得脸都青了，又拿端木棠梨没有办法，谁让他为了保证自己能活下去，不仅将手头上所有的道具都引爆掉，还弄死老三老四，用他们两个尸体成功庇护自己活着回到列车上。

正好在老四快被端木棠梨气疯时，列车播报到站声音响起。

Page (1/3)

"Well, we all owe the eldest lady a life. If the eldest lady needs anything, just call me."

Meng Yu wrote down his contact information in a small note and sent it to Duanmu Tangli.

Lao Zhao and Lao Wu saw Meng Yu's actions and left their contact information on the note. They were very aware that they had said in the mini-game that everything was valid. As long as the eldest lady had something to ask them to do, and it did not involve moral character or crime, they could call them for help.

Duanmu Tangli was not polite to these people and put the note away.

I don't know what the world will be like now, but having one more connection and help will be of great benefit to her.

"Huh? My sister! That fourth child only had an arm broken, and his body was not wiped out."

Mi Ying Wen Sheng was shocked to see the one-armed fourth sitting in his original position intact. Just now he just felt that something was wrong, so he had to look at the panoramic view of the box to find the figure of the fourth.

"I must have some special props in my hand to survive by stepping on the corpses of the other two people."

Mengyi didn't even look at the fourth child. People who survived by stepping on other people's corpses were the type of people she hated the most.

As someone who was taking the judge's exam, she was disgusted with indirect murderers like Lao Si, and her tone of voice was very harsh.

"Well, Mengyi is right. This person should be the same as the person who was taken away by the wolf girl before. He survived by stepping on other people's corpses. We need to be very alert to him and not be plotted by him."

Duanmu Tangli confirmed Mengyi's idea.

"Miss, don't be so nervous. The big gap with you is the third and sixth children. I have never had any conflicts with you in the little game."

"Sure enough, if the biting dog doesn't bark, your good brothers will not die unjustly."

Duanmu Tangli had an even worse sense of this person as the third and sixth children would be used by the fourth child even after they died.

However, due to the civilized riding rules on the train, Duanmu Tangli couldn't deal with this person directly.

Fortunately, it was time for the next stop, so Duanmu Tangli put aside the idea of ​​killing the other party. When he got off the car and returned to real life, he would definitely part ways with Lao Si and think more about it.

"The building blocks are stacked high. Passengers who ring the bell, please get off the train from the back door. You are welcome to ride the G444 Huangquan Road train next time."

The fourth child was so beaten by Duanmu Tangli that his face turned blue, and there was nothing he could do about Duanmu Tangli. In order to ensure that he could survive, he not only detonated all the props on hand, but also killed the third and fourth children, and used their two bodies to successfully protect himself and get back to the train alive.

Just when the fourth child was about to get mad at Duanmu Tangli, the train arrival announcement sounded.
